3.2.2
Workspace Management
The system shall allow users to:
• Create Personal Workspace
• View Existing Workspaces
• Delete Workspace
• Maintain Multiple Research Projects
3.2.3
Document Management
Users shall be able to:
• Upload PDF files
• Upload DOCX files
• Upload TXT files
• Delete Documents
• View Uploaded Documents
• Store Document Metadata
3.2.4
Document Processing
The document processing module shall:
• Extract Text
• Extract Metadata
• Detect Empty Pages
• Process Multiple File Types
3.2.5
Chunking Module
The system supports three chunking techniques:
• Fixed Size Chunking
• Recursive Chunking
• Semantic Chunking
